authorization: One fixed coupled DC completion trial: normative smoothing and fixed weighted DC coding on archived nonlinear DC. No sweep, peer maps or holdout tuning. All gates unchanged.

source.policy: One fixed configuration frozen after fixture checks, before any development quality result. Private writer and forward copies; no active src or public option changes.

rateAudit.policy: Read-only saved development outputs. All raw DC integers and previously audited AC sections are equal. Quality changes therefore come from the smoothing flag. Model delta includes the complete LF global section and local DC header, including alignment; no omitted global tree cost. These are same-distance deltas, not BD-rates.

archive.policy: Independent prototype snapshot, normalized import paths. No promotion admission. Contains development-only writer support; not active in public source.

auditArchive.policy: First-party decoder inspection, saved development bitstream audits and fixed-mode correctness fixtures. No production edits or native internal probe.

dcContextAudit.policy: Read-only existing development bitstreams. First-party decoder inspection copy exports its existing Modular parser. No native internal probe, new encode or parameter change.
dcContextAudit.limits: Reachable predictors are possible leaves after channel/group pruning, not observed usage counts. DC payload excludes any globally shared tree/histogram and matrices; whole-file comparisons remain authoritative.

visualReview.scope: Native-decoded nearby-byte pairs for the three worst development main max regressions.
visualReview.finding: Subtle grain and tonal differences in dark texture and vessel. Block-like tonal texture in blurred sign/wood. These views do not locate or dismiss metric peaks.

status: Rejected. All development means regress against AC 1.25 and nonlinear DC; main SSIM mean and five admitted per-image guards fail. No original or holdout qualification.
priorHoldout: The preceding AC 1.25 holdout still fails two SSIM guards, worst +10.568971938275642%. No new holdout result.
limitation: This ports the native tree decision, not native entropy clustering. The adapter writes 34 separate leaf histograms; sampled native streams cluster them into 5-11 DC histograms. It does not establish the cost of full native DC coding.

nextHypotheses.hypothesis: Audit selected-transform low-frequency reconstruction against native equations before another quality trial.
nextHypotheses.evidence: Smoothing degrades SSIM in 73/80 saved screen cases despite equal DC integers and AC sections. Native smoothing alone is not the missing repair; precise low-frequency error source remains unmeasured.

nextHypotheses.hypothesis: Cluster fixed DC contexts with the existing first-party entropy machinery.
nextHypotheses.evidence: Native uses 5-11 histograms for the same 34 leaves. Full model overhead and residual cost both rose; clustering could reduce coding cost but cannot repair the observed smoothing pixel losses. Gain unmeasured; another configuration needs approval.

nextHypotheses.hypothesis: Audit native DC source formation and preconditioning against our nonlinear input.
nextHypotheses.evidence: Native and our residual predictor agree structurally; source plane and selected-transform scaling equality is unproven. No numerical gain estimate yet.

remaining: One approved configuration exhausted. No new quality trial authorized. Peer forcing hooks remain on the public bundle path and must be removed before any merge. Branch not merge-ready.
